Assign cluster memberships to sites

Source: R/assign_clusters.R
assign_clusters.Rd

Biological data is hellinger transformed before distance calculations using vegan::decostand(bio, method = "hellinger")

assign_clusters(
  bins,
  bio,
  env = NULL,
  env_weight = 0.1,
  group_range = 2:50,
  ...
)

Arguments

bins

Dataframe with bin identifiers. For the same sites in the same order as bio and, if used, env

bio

Biological data as site * species

env

Environmental data as site * environment (in the same order and for the same sites as bio)

env_weight

Numeric. Value >= 0 and <= 1 used as weights argument to analogue::fuse().

...

Passed to: cluster::agnes(); genieclust::gclust() (use method = "genie"); or dbscan::hdbscan() (use method = "dbscan").

Value

A tibble of bins and their associated cluster (as a list column clusters) for each group size requested.
